dedupe_keys.name: verisk catastrophe risk models and the touchstone modelling platform

description: Verisk's Catastrophe and Risk Solutions business builds probabilistic catastrophe models that estimate the likelihood and severity of insured losses from natural and man-made disasters; Verisk says it pioneered catastrophe modelling in 1987. Coverage: models used for more than 110 countries; perils include North Atlantic hurricanes, Pacific typhoons and global tropical cyclones with storm surge, severe thunderstorms (hail, straight-line wind, tornadoes), earthquakes with building vulnerability, inland floods, extratropical cyclones and winter storm clusters, bushfire and wildfire including ignition and spread, agriculture (crops, forests, livestock), climate change conditioned views, terrorism, casualty catastrophes, and a probabilistic strikes, riots and civil commotion model for the United States. Format and access: models run in the Touchstone catastrophe risk modelling platform (and Touchstone Re for reinsurers), with geospatial analytics to find exposure concentrations; documentation, training and downloads sit behind a client portal; licensed to insurers, reinsurers and brokers, with consulting services. Licence: commercial licence, not read. Caveats: model documentation is client-confidential, so methods, event catalogues and vulnerability functions were not read; outputs are insured losses, not physical infrastructure performance. Simulation uses: stochastic event sets, hazard footprints and vulnerability functions for hazard exposure and fragility-based loss estimation of building and infrastructure portfolios, and climate-conditioned resilience analysis. Related records: JBA flood catastrophe models (data-jba-risk-global-flood-maps-data-and-cat-models) Cotality hazard risk data (data-cotality-corelogic-property-and-hazard-risk-data) and the competing Moody's RMS models (platform-moodys-rms-catastrophe-models).
